title: Safer writes to large CLAUDE.md files, shorter prompt for unknown models
headline: Claude no longer overwrites large instruction files it only partly read, unrecognized models on cloud providers get the shorter system prompt, and hook limits are set.

lines.text: Claude apps gateway: oidc.user_id_claim identifies people by an id_token claim other than sub, such as the oid claim of Microsoft Entra ID.
In fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message sends it immediately, like its key.
After signing in from the VS Code extension, managed settings and organization policy keep being fetched for the rest of the session.
Claude no longer overwrites a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subfolder after reading only its beginning; Write asks it to read the whole file or edit in place.
Skills tied to a folder or to paths: are found again after a Bash cd further into a git repository.
Rarely, the first reply after resuming a session in the terminal could be gone the next time it was resumed. Fixed.
A command with an invalid name no longer stops every command from loading, which could leave claude -p printing nothing.
Reading PDF pages no longer sometimes fails with "pdftoppm failed: Could not write image" while old session files are being cleaned up.

Effort changes during a task: the spinner, OpenTelemetry effort values and transcripts show the level actually in force, and the /model and /effort cache warning no longer claims the change always waits for your next message.
A session is no longer shown as waiting on you just because its last message mentioned something waiting on you mid-sentence.
Agent view: text cleared with Ctrl+C right before exiting no longer comes back on the next launch, and exiting with Ctrl+D from an empty ! input no longer reopens in shell mode.
Vim mode: d, c and y with a gj or gk count larger than the remaining lines now only move the cursor, as Vim does, instead of deleting or copying text.
/help and the / menu show a short description for /verify instead of the long one written for Claude.
The effort indicator in the prompt says when a mid-task change may wait for your next message, and drops the note once it no longer applies.
Cloud sessions: when WebFetch can't resolve a host, the error suggests it may be outside the allowed network domains, so Claude tells you which host to allow.

On Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and Mantle, model names Claude Code doesn't recognize (custom deployment names, inference profile ARNs) get the shorter system prompt even if Sonnet or Haiku is behind them. CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0 keeps the full one.
The automatic switch to another model after a flagged message now also applies to unrecognized model names such as custom deployments. CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK=1 turns it off.
Usage limit messages name the 5-hour window the "5-hour limit" rather than the "session limit". In VS Code, resets also show a clock time such as "Resets at 3:10 PM".
When you start a cloud session from the terminal, the server now chooses its title and git branch name.
Each session now runs at most 24 prompt and agent hooks at once (subagents included), plus up to 12 more that have outlasted their event's timeout; timeouts below one second are rounded up to one.
A subagent's autoCompactWindow can now lower the window set by CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW (it was ignored before), though it still can't raise it.

OpenTelemetry: mcp_server.name now reports the real name of fixed-URL remote MCP servers from plugins in the official Anthropic marketplace, not custom. The claude_code.safety_event event is no longer sent.
VS Code: when organization settings can't load or are refused at startup, the tab explains why and offers Retry or Sign in again instead of ending on a bare exit code.

Cloud sessions: routines that run in the cloud get an effort level in the model picker, and the setup script box in environment settings becomes a Bash editor with colours, line numbers and a Copy button.
Cloud sessions: when Claude adds a repository, opening that step shows a short table of what happened rather than raw JSON.

Cloud sessions: resending an unchanged message after a failed send no longer sometimes runs it twice, a failed environment creation shows its error inside the dialog, and Edit in a routine's menu opens the edit dialog.
Remote Control: an unarchived session shows as idle instead of working until a computer reconnects.
Claude Tag: when Slack shows a retry notice, it now names the model being used or says rate limits were reached, rather than a generic API error.

Claude Tag: a channel's switch and agent settings survive an older private channel going public with a new ID, Claude replies in channels whose environment has no network access, and files are posted in the right thread when Claude answers several threads in one channel.
Code Review: when GitHub delivers a push event late, the pull request's current commit is reviewed, not an old one or none.
